summary: Mechatronics engineer with experience in hardware-in-the-loop testing, applied machine learning, and generative AI application development. Comfortable moving between embedded/controls work and Python-based ML tooling.

experience.description: Develop and execute requirement-based HiL test packages for battery management software, covering functional-safety and quality-management requirements. Built an internal agentic RAG chatbot to answer documentation questions automatically, and lead evaluation of AI tooling for the wider test team.

Built an AI-based evaluation tool for powertrain driveability assessment, including a one-click pipeline usable by testers without ML experience. Trained a Temporal Fusion Transformer model for driveability prediction.
Designed a shift controller for a two-speed electric-vehicle transmission and developed vehicle subsystem models in Simulink. Delivered internal training on model-based controls development.
